chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“Keep your children, your insane persons, the raising of your voices, your buying and your selling, lost property, and the legal punishments and rulings away from your mosques.”

key_terms.الضَّالَّةَ: lost property; searching for or announcing lost items
key_terms.الْحُدُودَ وَالْأَحْكَامَ: legal punishments and rulings; judicial and penal matters
key_terms.رَفْعَ أَصْوَاتِكُمْ: raising your voices; loud speech or noise
key_terms.شِرَاءَكُمْ وَبَيْعَكُمْ: your buying and selling; commercial transactions
key_terms.صِبْيَانَكُمْ: your children; young boys or children whose presence may cause disturbance
key_terms.مَجَانِينَكُمْ: your insane persons; those lacking sound reason
key_terms.مَسَاجِدَكُمْ: your mosques; the places of worship belonging to the community

ai.seo_question: What activities should be kept away from the mosque in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs believers to preserve the sanctity and proper order of the mosques by keeping away matters that disturb worship or compromise their dignity. It highlights adab related to the mosque and indicates that worldly transactions, loud disturbance, and judicial enforcement are not to be conducted there.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Keep your children, the insane, raising of voices, buying and selling, seeking lost items, and administering legal punishments and rulings away from your mosques”.
